title: 10. Exercises: Topic 1: Classes and Objects - Exercises
summary: Complete all 10 exercises below. Each exercise builds upon the concepts learned in Topic 1.
objectives: Solve the Topic 1: Classes and Objects - Exercises exercises without looking at the lesson
Test edge cases and explain your approach

sections.title: Exercise Instructions
sections.body: Complete all 10 exercises below. Each exercise builds upon the concepts learned in Topic 1. Write your solutions in separate Python files and test them thoroughly.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Person Class
sections.body:
Create a `Person` class with the following requirements:
- Attributes: name, age, email, phone
- Methods: 
  - `__init__` to initialize all attributes
  - `get_info()` to return person's information
  - `have_birthday()` to increment age by 1
  - `update_contact(email, phone)` to update contact information
- Create 3 different person objects and test all methods

sections.title: Exercise 2: Product Inventory System
sections.body:
Create a `Product` class for an inventory management system:
- Attributes: product_id, name, price, quantity, category
- Methods:
  - `__init__` to initialize product details
  - `update_quantity(amount)` to add/remove stock
  - `get_total_value()` to calculate total inventory value
  - `is_low_stock(threshold=5)` to check if stock is low
  - `apply_discount(percentage)` to reduce price
- Create multiple products and demonstrate inventory operations

sections.title: Exercise 3: Library Management System
sections.body:
Create a `Library` class that manages books:
- Attributes: name, books (list), members (list)
- Methods:
  - `add_book(title, author, isbn)` to add new books
  - `remove_book(isbn)` to remove books
  - `search_book(title)` to find books by title
  - `get_total_books()` to count total books
  - `get_books_by_author(author)` to find books by author
- Implement book borrowing and returning functionality

sections.title: Exercise 4: Bank Transaction System
sections.body:
Create a `Transaction` class and enhance the `BankAccount` class:
- `Transaction` class with: transaction_id, type, amount, timestamp, description
- Enhanced `BankAccount` class with:
  - Transaction history tracking
  - Monthly statement generation
  - Transfer between accounts
  - Interest calculation (simple interest)
- Create multiple accounts and perform various transactions

sections.title: Exercise 5: Student Grade Management
sections.body:
Create a comprehensive `Student` class:
- Attributes: student_id, name, grades (dictionary), attendance
- Methods:
  - `add_grade(subject, score)` to add grades
  - `get_average()` to calculate GPA
  - `get_highest_subject()` to find best performing subject
  - `get_attendance_percentage()` to calculate attendance
  - `is_eligible_for_scholarship()` (GPA > 3.5 and attendance > 90%)
- Create a class to manage multiple students

sections.title: Exercise 6: Restaurant Menu System
sections.body:
Create a `MenuItem` class and `Restaurant` class:
- `MenuItem`: name, price, category, description, is_available
- `Restaurant`: name, menu (list of MenuItem), orders
- Methods:
  - Add/remove menu items
  - Search items by category
  - Calculate total order value
  - Apply special discounts
  - Generate menu report
- Implement order processing functionality

sections.title: Exercise 7: Vehicle Fleet Management
sections.body:
Create a `Vehicle` class and `Fleet` class:
- `Vehicle`: make, model, year, mileage, fuel_type, is_available
- `Fleet`: name, vehicles (list), maintenance_schedule
- Methods:
  - Add/remove vehicles from fleet
  - Find vehicles by make/model
  - Calculate total fleet value
  - Schedule maintenance
  - Generate fleet report
- Implement vehicle booking system

sections.title: Exercise 8: Employee Payroll System
sections.body:
Create an `Employee` class with payroll functionality:
- Attributes: employee_id, name, position, salary, hours_worked, overtime_hours
- Methods:
  - `calculate_salary()` to compute total pay
  - `add_overtime(hours)` to add overtime hours
  - `get_tax_deduction()` to calculate tax (assume 20%)
  - `get_net_salary()` to get final pay
  - `request_raise(percentage)` to request salary increase
- Create a payroll processing system

sections.title: Exercise 9: Shopping Cart System
sections.body:
Create a `CartItem` class and `ShoppingCart` class:
- `CartItem`: product, quantity, price
- `ShoppingCart`: items (list), customer_id
- Methods:
  - Add/remove items from cart
  - Update item quantities
  - Calculate total cost
  - Apply coupon codes
  - Generate invoice
- Implement inventory checking and stock validation

sections.title: Exercise 10: Task Management System
sections.body:
Create a `Task` class and `TaskManager` class:
- `Task`: task_id, title, description, priority, status, due_date, assigned_to
- `TaskManager`: tasks (list), team_members
- Methods:
  - Create new tasks
  - Assign tasks to team members
  - Update task status
  - Get tasks by priority/status
  - Calculate completion percentage
  - Generate task reports
- Implement deadline tracking and notifications

sections.title: Additional Challenges (Optional)
sections.body:
### Challenge 1: Data Validation
Add input validation to all your classes:
- Check for valid email formats
- Ensure positive numbers for prices/quantities
- Validate phone number formats
- Check for required fields

### Challenge 2: File Operations
Implement file saving/loading for your classes:
- Save objects to JSON files
- Load objects from files
- Export data to CSV format
- Backup and restore functionality

### Challenge 3: Error Handling
Add comprehensive error handling:
- Custom exception classes
- Try-catch blocks for all operations
- Meaningful error messages
- Graceful error recovery

sections.title: Submission Guidelines
sections.body:
1. Create separate Python files for each exercise
2. Include proper documentation and comments
3. Test all methods with various scenarios
4. Ensure code follows Python naming conventions
5. Add error handling where appropriate
